# 🧩 Puzzle Time!

Welcome to Puzzle Time - a fast-paced puzzle game!

## How to Play

1. **Drag pieces** onto the board to fill all the empty spaces
2. **Double-tap** a piece to rotate it 90°
3. **Complete the puzzle** before time runs out!
4. **Faster = More points** - You get bonus points for time remaining

## Scoring

- 🎯 **100 points** for completing a puzzle
- ⏱️ **+1 point** per second remaining
- 🏆 **Maximum: 160 points** per round

howToPlayMd:
# 🧩 How to Play Puzzle Time

## Objective
Fill all empty spaces on the board using the given pieces before the 60-second timer runs out!

## Controls

- **Drag pieces** from the tray onto the board
- **Double-tap/click** a piece to rotate it 90°
- **Tap a placed piece** to return it to the tray
- Pieces will **snap to the grid** automatically

## Difficulty Levels

| Level | Pieces | Board Size |
|-------|--------|------------|
| 🟢 Easy | 3 pieces | Small |
| 🟡 Medium | 4 pieces | Medium |
| 🔴 Hard | 5 pieces | Large |

## Scoring

- **100 points** base for completing a puzzle
- **+1 point** for each second remaining
- **Maximum: 160 points** per round (solved instantly)
- **0 points** if time runs out

## Tips

- 💡 Start with corner and edge pieces
- 🔄 Remember you can rotate pieces!
- ⚡ Speed matters for bonus points
- 🎯 All pieces must be used to complete the puzzle
